text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — the automated driver rollout to 573 started ~10m ago in eu-west-3 canary and ~18% of GPU nodes failed to finish provisioning (nodes stuck at initrd). Not massive but looks systemic.
Liam O'Connor: ugh. Do we have a quick signal? which pool?
Maria Chen: pool: gpu-worker-eu-west-3-autoscale. Logs show DKMS build failing + systemd unit 'nvhost.service' never coming up.
Kai Patel: can you paste the dkms output?
Maria Chen: paste below:
```
Building module for kernel: 5.15.0-71-generic (x86_64)
Error! Bad return status for module build on kernel: 5.15.0-71-generic (x86_64)
Consult /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/573/build/make.log for more information.
make[1]: *** [module] Error 2
modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia_573 not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-71-generic
```
Nisha Rao: that modprobe error + missing module dir smells like kernel-headers mismatch or DKMS failed to install. secureboot enabled?
Maria Chen: secureboot=enabled on these hosts (firmware managed in that region). make.log has signing errors: 'sign-file: certificate routine:private key routines:unknown' and 'MOK not found'.
ops-oncall: pinged — I'm cordoning the remaining canary nodes and shifting new provisioning attempts to fallback pool with 565 images to avoid capacity loss.
Liam O'Connor: good. Any nodes with nvhost errors or is it only the DKMS failure?
Maria Chen: journald snippet: 
```
Mar 12 09:04:22 gpu-node-23 systemd[1]: Starting NVHost service...
Mar 12 09:04:22 gpu-node-23 nvhost[1234]: failed to load kernel module nvidia_573: -2
Mar 12 09:04:23 gpu-node-23 systemd[1]: nvhost.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Mar 12 09:04:23 gpu-node-23 systemd[1]: nvhost.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
```
Kai Patel: two hypotheses: (A) our DKMS packaging didn't include prebuilt signed modules and MOK enrollment step failed during automated provisioning, or (B) kernel headers package on the image doesn't match the runtime kernel so DKMS can't build modules.
Nisha Rao: we hit this before — secureboot + unattended DKMS requires MOK enrollment during first boot, which our cloud-init path bypasses. For canary we should have tested a secureboot path.
Maria Chen: agree. For now eu-west-3 capacity is low; ops-oncall moved traffic to us-east-1 fallback pool. Heads-up that cost/latency will spike for in-flight jobs.
devops-bot: Autocordon: gpu-worker-eu-west-3-autoscale (5 nodes) - reason: driver-573 dkms failures
ops-oncall: I've started a rollback to driver 565 for the remaining canary nodes and triggered reprovision with the 565 image. 3 of 5 recovered. Two nodes still hanging — investigating.
Liam O'Connor: those two — are they irrecoverable or stuck because they still have the partial 573 artifacts?
Maria Chen: they have a leftover /lib/modules/nvidia* symlink pointing to a non-existent 573 dir plus broken initramfs entries. Rebuilding initramfs and re-running dkms/install might fix, but secureboot will reject unsigned modules.
Kai Patel: quick mitigation: add a preflight check to the rollout playbook that verifies (1) kernel-headers installed and match uname -r, (2) MOK enrollment success or secureboot=false, (3) DKMS test-build on image. If any fail, abort rollout for that pool.
Nisha Rao: also add a check for leftover /lib/modules symlinks and stale dkms status. I'll file the followup.
Maria Chen: opened INC-2026 with steps and nodes affected. Adding short summary here: rollback to 565, cordoned 5 nodes, moved traffic to us-east fallback, manual cleanup queued for 2 nodes.
Liam O'Connor: do we want to disable secureboot in canary images until we have a signed workflow?
ops-oncall: disabling secureboot ASAP in canary image might be fastest but touches compliance. I'll coordinate with security.
Maria Chen: long-term: add MOK enrolment step into cloud-init and include signed modules in our driver artifacts. Also test the entire path in staging (secureboot=enabled).
Kai Patel: I'll send a PR with a rollout preflight script and DKMS sanity checks — tagging @Nisha for review.
Nisha Rao: ack. Also add capacity threshold gating — if fallback requires cross-region shift, abort or require manual approval.
Maria Chen: thanks all. I'll post an RCA draft after the cleanup. :white_check_mark:
